messages.content: What parameters do the viscous friction force depend on, and in which case should it be taken into account for the physical pendulum model? In your response the last word of each sentence must become the first word of the next sentence.

message.content:
The viscous friction force depends on the angular velocity.
Velocity determines the magnitude of this resistive term.
This term is significant when damping effects are non-negligible.
Negligible damping assumptions fail in real-world oscillations.
Oscillations eventually decay due to energy dissipation.
Dissipation requires including a linear velocity-dependent term.
Term inclusion modifies the standard differential equation.
Equation solutions then show exponential decay envelopes.
